extraWatch.what: AAIP Worker EOI points grid PDF

minimumLanguage: CLB 4 (English) or NCLC 4 (French) in all four abilities to submit a Worker EOI

factors.label: Where your highest education was completed in Canada
options: Completed in another province or territory

factors.label: English: lowest CLB of the four abilities
options: CLB 3 or lower, or no test

factors.label: French: lowest NCLC of the four abilities
options: NCLC 3 or lower, or no test

factors.label: Total work experience, in Canada and abroad
Work experience in Canada
options: 6 months or more in another province or territory

factors.label: Parent, child or sibling in Alberta who is a citizen or permanent resident over 18
Job offer for permanent full-time employment in Alberta
Job offer in a select rural community or sector
options: Rural Renewal Stream endorsement letter from a designated community
Tourism and hospitality job offer from a member of a required sector association
Law enforcement job offer from a member of the Alberta Association of Chiefs of Police

factors.label: Location of the Alberta job offer
options: Other Alberta community outside the Calgary and Edmonton metropolitan areas

factors.label: Job offer in a regulated occupation, with Alberta certification or licence

bilingual.rule: CLB or NCLC 4 or higher in both English and French

languageRule: Points come from the lowest of the four abilities on the test; Alberta scores English and French and gives the higher of the two, plus 3 bilingual points if both are at level 4 or higher.
